fields.label: Name(s) shown on return
Identifying number
Line 1a — Rental real estate activities with active participation: activities with net income (enter the amount from Part IV, column (a))
Line 1b — Rental real estate activities with active participation: activities with net loss (enter the amount from Part IV, column (b))
Line 1c — Rental real estate activities with active participation: prior years' unallowed losses (enter the amount from Part IV, column (c))
Line 1d — Combine lines 1a, 1b, and 1c
Line 2a — All other passive activities: activities with net income (enter the amount from Part V, column (a))
Line 2b — All other passive activities: activities with net loss (enter the amount from Part V, column (b))
Line 2c — All other passive activities: prior years' unallowed losses (enter the amount from Part V, column (c))
Line 2d — Combine lines 2a, 2b, and 2c
Line 3 — Combine lines 1d and 2d and subtract any prior year unallowed CRD
Line 4 — Enter the smaller of the loss on line 1d or the loss on line 3
Line 5 — Enter $150,000. If married filing separately, see instructions
Line 6 — Enter modified adjusted gross income, but not less than zero
Line 7 — Subtract line 6 from line 5
Line 8 — Multiply line 7 by 50% (0.50). Do not enter more than $25,000
Line 9 — Enter the smaller of line 4 or line 8
Line 10 — Add the income, if any, on lines 1a and 2a and enter the total
Line 11 — Total losses allowed from all passive activities for 2025. Add lines 9 and 10
